verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks that push asynchronous payment status changes so you don't have to poll, including a payment-outcome webhook in its Google agentic flow. The Customer Area keeps a log of all webhook events sent to your server, and Management API tooling can list, get and test webhook configurations. Missing for 10: any evidence of webhook signing/HMAC verification, documented automatic retry behavior, event replay or resend capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
